title: Chosen lift normalization extends to arbitrary lifts
statement: For a commutative ring A, ideal I, degree n and an A-linear conormal-to-self-Tor map c, the chosen-lift wedge certificate [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison-tate-construction] implies the full arbitrary-lift normalization predicate [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-predicate].

source.place: Part (2), tensoring chain homotopies and equality of induced homology maps

proof.text: For the given tuple and resolution take the lift b supplied by the certificate. The arbitrary lift a has the same augmentation. Apply the Koszul comparison homotopy lemma.
Tensor the homotopy with A/I using Functor.mapHomotopy. Apply Homotopy.homologyMap_eq and substitute into the certificate formula. This proves the required formula for a.
